title: Portfolio Risk Weights and Margin Contributions — 4-Component Confirmed Portfolio

atrBasedRiskWeights.note: ATR estimated from 18.52yr historical averages. EUR-denominated risk per contract per ATR move.
atrBasedRiskWeights.equalRiskWeighting_basis: 1 contract each at equal ATR risk weighting

scenario_sharedFDXS.note: Assumes DAX1H and DAX2H signals do not overlap significantly — operationally risky

15000.note: PASS — but shared FDXS caveat applies

scenario_separateFDXS.note: Correct allocation when DAX1H and DAX2H can have simultaneous open positions

20000.note: PASS — first compliant level for separate FDXS

simultaneityAnalysis.dax1h_timeframe: 1H bars — entries triggered on 1H bar close
simultaneityAnalysis.dax2h_timeframe: 2H bars — entries triggered on 2H bar close
simultaneityAnalysis.overlapRisk: HIGH — at any 2H boundary, both strategies can simultaneously have open positions
simultaneityAnalysis.recommendation: Use 2×FDXS (separate per strategy) for correct risk accounting. Minimum capital: €20,000.
simultaneityAnalysis.sharedFDXS_risk: If only 1×FDXS allocated and both strategies trigger simultaneously, second strategy cannot enter — creates execution risk and tracking error vs backtest
